notes:
**Every rule you built was the one thing no backup carried.** The account screen promised cloud backup covers "your paper trades, watchlists, alerts and strategies". Three of those four were true. A new phone came back with an empty Lab - including scripts the AI had been paid to compile - while the screen said your account had been saved. Fixed, and your customised coach goes with it.

**There is now a backup file you own.** No sign-in, nothing uploaded: one file with your account, watchlists, alerts, drawings and every rule, kept wherever you keep things. The code was written and tested months ago and never given a button, so the only way off a phone was the one that asks for your name and email. Your broker keys are not in it and never will be.

**A delta rule that cannot see its contract now says so** instead of sitting there looking like the market never obliged.
